question: Which open resource pairs genotype with an allelic molecular readout, and how much of the attribution layer's element set could it reach? Feasibility only: counts of overlap, no allelic outcome read, nothing registered that measures.

candidates.name: GTEx v8 allelic expression (Castel et al. 2020, Genome Biology)
candidates.paired: RNA-seq haplotype counts per gene per sample (phASER, with and without WASP) with the donors' WGS genotypes
candidates.access: open: the phASER haplotype expression matrices on the GTEx portal (adult-gtex bucket, haplotype-expression/v8/); controlled (dbGaP phs000424.v8): SNP-level ASE, the WGS genotypes and the read-back phased genotypes. No haplotype expression in v10 or v11 (bulk-qtl and bulk-gex only)
candidates.licence: GTEx portal open-access data; article CC BY 4.0; genotypes under dbGaP terms
candidates.size: phASER_WASP_GTEx_v8_matrix.gw_phased.txt.gz 461.5 MB (the three other matrices 513.6 to 555.0 MB)
candidates.format: one string per gene per sample, HAP_A_COUNT|HAP_B_COUNT; no variant ids, no genotypes
candidates.feasible_here: the open matrix pairs with nothing open: which haplotype carries an element's allele is in the controlled genotypes, so no element-level prediction can be checked without dbGaP access (not requested)

candidates.name: Geuvadis (Lappalainen et al. 2013), ArrayExpress E-GEUV-1
candidates.paired: LCL RNA-seq ASE per individual per site, with 1000 Genomes phased genotypes
candidates.samples: 462 unique RNA samples (EUR 373, YRI 89); one cell type (LCL)
candidates.access: open (BioStudies E-GEUV-1, no registration); the 1000 Genomes 30x phased panel is open
candidates.licence: EMBL-EBI terms of use; IGSR: 1000 Genomes data available without embargo
candidates.size: GD462.ASE.COV8.ANNOT_PTV.txt.gz 918 MB; phased genotypes 621 MB (chr22) to 3.5 GB (chr1); one BAM per sample
candidates.format: ASE: INDIVIDUAL, RSID, CHR, POS, ALLELES, REF_COUNT, NONREF_COUNT, TOTAL_COUNT, REF_RATIO (per-sample null), binomial PVALUE, GENOTYPE; the name says COV8, a coverage floor the README does not define
candidates.assembly: GRCh37 (1000 Genomes phase 1); a lift or a GRCh38 re-count is needed
candidates.feasible_here: yes for the table (under 1 GB); the genotype side can come from the GRCh38 30x phased panel instead, which this probe streams for chr21

candidates.name: EN-TEx (Rozowsky et al. 2023, Cell)
candidates.paired: haplotype-resolved read counts for ATAC, DNase, histone and CTCF/POLR2A ChIP and RNA-seq on each donor's own phased diploid genome
candidates.samples: 4 donors, about 30 tissues, 1,635 datasets; the AS pipeline ran on about 1,000 samples
candidates.access: open: 'fully open-consented and accessible without registration'; the four donors' personalized genome assemblies on the ENCODE portal (ENCSR792RVV, ENCSR866HYZ, ENCSR780BKN, ENCSR083ETH; 1.7 to 3.6 GB each)
candidates.licence: ENCODE data use policy ('freely download, analyze and publish ... without restrictions'); article CC BY 4.0
candidates.size: cCREs_default_AS.tsv 711 MB; genes_default_AS.tsv 94 MB; hetSNVs_default_AS.tsv 2.5 GB
candidates.format: chr, start, end, region_id (cCRE V2 accession or Ensembl gene id), hap1_count, hap2_count, experiment, donor, tissue, assay, hap1_allele_ratio, p_betabinom, imbalance_significance
candidates.allele_counts: provided (AlleleSeq2: reads mapped to both personal haplotypes, beta-binomial test)
candidates.feasible_here: yes: both tables are under 1 GB and keyed to cCREs and genes, the element and readout sides of the archive's pairs

candidates.name: ADASTRA release Mabel v6.1 (Nov 2024; allele-specific TF binding)
candidates.paired: ChIP-seq allelic read counts at heterozygous SNVs called from the reads themselves
candidates.samples: 1,073 TFs and 649 cell types from 15,970 GTRD alignments (Bill Cipher v5 base)
candidates.access: open (Zenodo 14174114); the ADASTRA site's downloads page returned HTTP 502 on 2026-09-28
candidates.size: ADASTRA.v.6.1.Mabel.zip 942.7 MB; the four context-cell files 26 MB compressed
candidates.format: per cell type and per TF: every eligible SNV passing the coverage thresholds, with aggregated effect sizes and FDR per allele (hg38, 0-based start)
candidates.allele_counts: aggregated statistics per SNV per cell type, not per-sample counts
candidates.feasible_here: yes, by HTTP ranges on the zip; binding only, so it reads the element side and never the gene

candidates.name: UDACHA release IceKing v1.0.3 (June 2023; allele-specific accessibility)
candidates.paired: DNase-, ATAC- and FAIRE-seq allelic read counts at SNVs called from the reads
candidates.licence: no data licence found on the site; the article (Nat Commun 2025) is CC BY-NC-ND 4.0
candidates.size: UDACHA_IceKing_May2023_release.zip 826.5 MB; the context-cell files 12 MB compressed
candidates.format: per cell type per assay: #chr, start, end, mean_bad, id, max_cover, ref, alt, n_reps, then effect sizes, p-values and FDRs; no readme in the zip, so that a file lists every coverage-passing SNV and not only the significant ones is not stated by this release
candidates.allele_counts: aggregated statistics per SNV per cell type
candidates.feasible_here: yes, by HTTP ranges; accessibility only, element side

candidates.name: AlleleDB (Chen et al. 2016)
candidates.paired: ASB and ASE on 1000 Genomes individuals' personal genomes
candidates.size: accE v2.1 96 MB, accB 6.1 MB, ASE 7.6 MB, ASB 213 kB
candidates.feasible_here: reachable, but for this purpose EN-TEx (same lab, personal genomes, GRCh38, tissues) and ADASTRA/UDACHA (binding, accessibility) cover it

candidates.name: ENCODE4 Hi-C genophasing (43 biosamples)
candidates.paired: phased variant calls from Hi-C, including HepG2 and IMR-90; its 'allele-specific variants' output is the Hi-C diploid layout, not a molecular readout
candidates.samples: 43 annotations (HepG2 ENCSR777ARQ, IMR-90 ENCSR425DIX; none for K562 or GM12878)
candidates.allele_counts: none; would be computed from ENCODE RNA, DNase or ATAC BAMs
candidates.feasible_here: genotype side only; allele counting from multi-GB BAMs is possible by ranges (genomeos/genome/bam_range.py) but is a build, not a probe

candidates.name: GIAB HG002 RNA-seq (NIST RNA-seq pilot)
candidates.paired: Illumina mRNA and lncRNA, PacBio and ONT reads on three HG002 cell stocks (GM24385, GM26105, GM27730), with the Q100 assembly phased by parent
candidates.size: mRNA BAMs 7.3 to 9.1 GB each (.bai 4 to 5 MB); FASTQ 6 to 7 GB per mate
candidates.feasible_here: by range reads of the indexed BAM at the heterozygous sites this probe counts; one individual, so it can check a direction but cannot separate an element from its linked variants

ADASTRA: every column after the position (BAD, coverage, effect sizes, FDR, motif)

sources.accession: GIAB HG002 T2T Q100 dipcall calls and v5.0q small-variant benchmark bed
1000 Genomes 30x phased panel (NYGC, Byrska-Bishop et al. 2022)
geneimprint.com human imprinted genes (symbols only, as a filter)
GTEx v8 gene median TPM (LCL column only)
ENCODE ENCFF361XMX (ENCSR000AKC) GM12878 H3K27ac replicated peaks

parameters.het: SNV whose GT holds two different alleles; indels and symbolic alleles excluded
parameters.element_overlap: at least one base (EN-TEx V2 regions to archive V3 elements)
parameters.target_exons: union of every GENCODE v50 exon of the target symbol's gene
parameters.lcl_context: element overlaps a GM12878 H3K27ac peak and target GTEx v8 median TPM >= 1.0 in 'Cells - EBV-transformed lymphocytes'

exclusions: indels and symbolic alleles: allele counting reads SNVs
chrX and chrY from the autosomal pair counts of the two genomes (X inactivation in NA12878, hemizygous in HG002)
HG002 dipcall calls with a FILTER other than PASS or '.'
the population count covers chr21 only; the panel's other chromosomes were not streamed
every allelic count, ratio, effect-size and significance column (label-blind)

model_dependencies.unpinned: unpinned: no model version was requested. dna_client.create(api_key) and create(api_key, timeout=300) leave model_version None, so every ScoreVariantRequest carried an empty model_version and the server chose. No response message carries a model version (model_version is a request field only in dna_model_service.proto) and no cache file, result or job log records one, so which model answered cannot be established from disk
model_dependencies.documented_default: ALL_FOLDS, the distilled all-folds model, per the comment on alphagenome 0.9.0 dna_model.ModelVersion; a client document, not verified against the server
